# Python packages for the `zephyr / qemu_cortex_m3` CI job (.github/workflows/ci.yml),
# every one pinned by version and by sha256. The job installs this file with
# `pip install --require-hashes`, so a package that changes on PyPI under the
# same version stops the job instead of running in it.
#
# What it resolves: west, and the three Zephyr requirement files the job needs
# (the job's comment says why these three), at the Zephyr revision in
# west.yml, for the job's Python on Linux x86-64.
#
# The job then checks that what is installed still satisfies those three files
# as the fetched Zephyr states them. A Zephyr bump that needs a package this
# file lacks, or a version it excludes, fails that step with the requirement
# named. Regenerate then, from a directory holding the three files of the new
# revision (zephyr/scripts/):
#
#   printf 'west==<version>\n-r requirements-base.txt\n-r requirements-build-test.txt\n-r requirements-run-test.txt\n' > in.txt
#   uv pip compile in.txt --python-version <the job's python-version> \
#     --python-platform x86_64-manylinux_2_28 --generate-hashes --no-header \
#     -o requirements.txt
#
# and keep this header.
